Havell’s defence (1911) of Indian sculpture and painting as the expression of Indian philosophy and religion, against the judgement of the colonial art schools.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Harold B. Lee Library, Brigham Young University; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The ideals of Indian art · Havell, E. B. (Ernest Binfield), 1861-1934 · 1911, 300 scanned pages. Published 1911; Ernest Binfield Havell died 1934; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
